newsitem.title: USA: Donaldson Co acquires tube manufacturer.
newsitem.headline: Donaldson Co acquires tube manufacturer.

text.p: Donaldson Co Inc said Tuesday it had agreed to purchase the assets of Armada Tube Group. Terms were not disclosed.
It said the buy would enable it to extend its product line and add facilities to produce complete exhaust systems and intake tubing.
The assets being bought include Armada Tube Products Inc of Armada, Mich., and Lakeside Tube Fabricators Inc of Mooresville, N.C.
Donaldson expects to complete the transaction in the last week of April.

Armada, a private company with annual sales of more than $15 million, makes bent and fabricated tubular assemblies for exhaust and other engine-related products. It serves the medium- and heavy-duty transportation market.
Donaldson makes filtration and exhaust systems and replacement parts.
Shares of Donaldson were trading unchanged at 36.
